caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet centered on a plain, off-white background. The cabinet is rectangular and consists of two main sections: the upper section has an octagonal, panel-like feature with an oval-shaped handle or keyhole in the middle, bordered by a reddish outline, while the lower section contains two vertically aligned rectangular panels, each also bordered with a reddish line. The cabinet has four plain, straight legs and a slightly protruding rectangular top. The wood grain is visible throughout, and the coloration predominantly features shades of light brown with accents of red and black. There are no other objects or decorations present in the drawing.
title: Side View of Hartford Chest
